title: Stop Wasting Your Claude Code Usage Limits
description: If you keep hitting limits in Claude Code, it’s usually a workflow problem. A few small command tweaks can stretch your context way further.
transcript: If you are burning through Claude code usage limits, you're probably doing it wrong. Here are three fixes. First, use /model opus plan. That forces Claude to use opus 4.6 for planning, but sonnet for execution. Opus eats tokens fast. Sonnet 4.6 handles actual coding just fine. Second, run /compact when conversations get long. Claude rereads your entire chat history on every message. Compact compresses it into a tight summary, so you keep going without burning context. Third, add ultra thing to the end of your prompts before complex tasks. It forces Claude to plan the full solution before writing a single line of code. The developers who master these workflows now will have a compounding advantage because the ceiling on what one person can ship with AI is going up every quarter. Make sure to hit that follow button for more AI and tech news tips and breakdowns.
